debac42d-e22d-4cd6-92d5-25f48745e80c.name: care_contexts
debac42d-e22d-4cd6-92d5-25f48745e80c.comment: Citus: DISTRIBUTED by iq_tenant_id. The discoverable health-record units linkable to an ABHA. One row per (patient, source clinical event). Mirrors the production ABDM care-context concept but generalised: a care_context is *anything* that can become an ABDM-discoverable record (OPD visit, lab report, prescription, discharge summary, scanned document) -- with origin tracking that distinguishes platform-internal sources from external HIU-received and from legacy-system ingested records.

46b4166a-76f7-45df-9975-ad5697d45061.name: record_bundle_manifests
46b4166a-76f7-45df-9975-ad5697d45061.comment: Citus: DISTRIBUTED by iq_tenant_id. Manifest per FHIR Document Bundle produced or received. Records what bundle exists, what NRCeS profile it conforms to, who produced it, and where the bytes live. The bytes themselves are in bundle_storage. Per ADR-0022 (immutable) and ADR-0023 (assembly origin).

12b0402b-49c3-44b0-84cb-839d30c85d24.name: bundle_storage
12b0402b-49c3-44b0-84cb-839d30c85d24.comment: Citus: DISTRIBUTED by iq_tenant_id. Byte-exact storage of FHIR Document Bundles. INSERT-only: rows are NEVER updated. On erasure, rows are DELETE'd and an erasure_log row is written. Storage strategy: JSONB for v1 (PostgreSQL); object-storage extraction is a future optimisation noted in phasing.

2a1b69de-4b66-4fcc-a412-a1c491116783.name: external_health_records
2a1b69de-4b66-4fcc-a412-a1c491116783.comment: Citus: DISTRIBUTED by iq_tenant_id. Inbox for FHIR Document Bundles received from external HIPs via M3. One row per (consent_artifact, source HIP, received bundle). The bundle bytes live in bundle_storage (linked via record_bundle_manifests); this table holds the receipt metadata and HIU-side display index.

87fbc68b-6ee5-4267-8260-fe492f3ec475.name: timeline_index
87fbc68b-6ee5-4267-8260-fe492f3ec475.comment: Citus: DISTRIBUTED by iq_tenant_id. Denormalised, patient-keyed timeline projection. Source-of-truth-NEVER (rebuildable from care_contexts + record_bundle_manifests + external_health_records by replay). Read by the doctor's timeline UI and by ABDM HIP discovery responses to avoid joining three tables on every read.

a8ad08a5-7d78-4b72-84b2-eb27fe9e248c.name: erasure_log
a8ad08a5-7d78-4b72-84b2-eb27fe9e248c.comment: Citus: DISTRIBUTED by iq_tenant_id. Append-only log of erasures performed under ABDM consent expiry. Provides regulatory evidence that the platform honoured the consent's dataEraseAt obligation. Per ADR-0022 / DPDP Act section 11.

d1d954a7-5254-458b-9b55-c2d22a4bca42.name: abha_linkage_status
d1d954a7-5254-458b-9b55-c2d22a4bca42.comment: Whether this care context has been published to ABDM as a linked context. 'linkable' = patient has ABHA but linking not yet performed. 'linked' = ABDM gateway has acknowledged the link. | CHECK: abha_linkage_status IN ('not_linked','linkable','linked','revoked')

69722bf3-17ed-4c19-9143-46fbf65f8996.name: abdm_reference_number
69722bf3-17ed-4c19-9143-46fbf65f8996.comment: ABDM-side reference number (the gateway-recognised pointer). NULL until linked.

850d5c9a-8400-42f0-a0c8-79bf2a433ce0.name: source_origin
850d5c9a-8400-42f0-a0c8-79bf2a433ce0.comment: Distinguishes records authored inside the platform from records ingested from a legacy system through the Integration Hub from records received from an external HIP via M3. | CHECK: source_origin IN ('platform_module','legacy_system','external_abdm')

7f557e0a-c2c9-4610-9dce-c443ba94b802.name: source_system_id
7f557e0a-c2c9-4610-9dce-c443ba94b802.comment: For platform_module: module name (e.g., 'opd', 'lab'). For legacy_system: integration name. For external_abdm: external HIP id.

5eb5f8e9-1053-4aee-a617-72ab462c0b85.name: source_record_type
5eb5f8e9-1053-4aee-a617-72ab462c0b85.comment: Maps 1:1 to ABDM HI types. | CHECK: source_record_type IN ('opd_visit','ipd_admission','lab_report','prescription','radiology_report','discharge_summary','immunisation_record','wellness_record','health_document','external_record')

478c58bd-8a28-4838-95b9-1e04d65083fb.name: source_record_id
478c58bd-8a28-4838-95b9-1e04d65083fb.comment: Primary key in the source module's table. NULL for external_abdm-origin records (no internal source).

fbbd7abe-a1fb-412d-881f-88a1b5f1639a.name: encounter_id
fbbd7abe-a1fb-412d-881f-88a1b5f1639a.comment: Optional grouping. Multiple care contexts (visit + prescription + lab) may share an encounter.

a5414357-d02a-4516-8c00-edda7ec8febb.name: display
a5414357-d02a-4516-8c00-edda7ec8febb.comment: Patient-facing display name for the care context (e.g., 'OPD Visit at AIIMS Delhi -- 12 Mar 2026', 'CBC Lab Report -- 14 Mar 2026').

ff247764-950a-4da4-9ba8-8baad92abecd.name: supersedes_id
ff247764-950a-4da4-9ba8-8baad92abecd.comment: When status='superseded' or when this row supersedes another, points to the prior care_context. Implements the FHIR Composition.relatesTo amendment pattern at the care-context level.

b54b0f63-b3ce-45e4-8d6b-32085e0d1aac.name: sensitivity_labels
b54b0f63-b3ce-45e4-8d6b-32085e0d1aac.comment: Optional labels (e.g., {'restricted','psychiatry','hiv'}) to gate disclosure under finer policy.

69cce132-410b-4202-a90a-ffc0dc85dd24.name: data_erase_at
69cce132-410b-4202-a90a-ffc0dc85dd24.comment: For external_abdm-origin records, the ABDM consent-mandated erasure deadline. Polled by the erasure scheduler.

80d6b6c3-88b0-41c3-ae51-1d16cef5b29f.name: care_context_id
80d6b6c3-88b0-41c3-ae51-1d16cef5b29f.comment: The care context this bundle represents.

cbf622d3-b4a0-4836-8aed-aeb23f7808eb.name: bundle_kind
cbf622d3-b4a0-4836-8aed-aeb23f7808eb.comment: Maps to NRCeS R4 profile names. | CHECK: bundle_kind IN ('OpConsultRecord','Prescription','DischargeSummary','DiagnosticReport','HealthDocumentRecord','ImmunizationRecord','WellnessRecord')

f4098f0b-8b1a-4ab9-82cd-92524f3a8578.name: producer_kind
f4098f0b-8b1a-4ab9-82cd-92524f3a8578.comment: Who composed this bundle. | CHECK: producer_kind IN ('platform_module','external_hip')

84d577d8-06be-4b7d-9bf4-7d3e63c5cd29.name: producer_id
84d577d8-06be-4b7d-9bf4-7d3e63c5cd29.comment: Module name when producer_kind='platform_module'; external HIP id when producer_kind='external_hip'.

6dd2b310-d585-4b67-96c1-0707d412eee9.name: validation_status
6dd2b310-d585-4b67-96c1-0707d412eee9.comment: Result of NRCeS profile validation. 'not_validated' = received from external HIP and validation skipped (we trust the HIP's declared conformance and store the artifact). | CHECK: validation_status IN ('pending','valid','invalid','not_validated')

824f9123-5e2b-44b1-8285-e1843dd7067d.name: bundle_hash
824f9123-5e2b-44b1-8285-e1843dd7067d.comment: SHA-256 of the bundle bytes. Critical for integrity and signature verification.

056ae546-9098-4d2b-acc5-e1ac887c05ae.name: signature_storage_ref
056ae546-9098-4d2b-acc5-e1ac887c05ae.comment: Vault/object-storage ref for an optional digital signature over the bundle.

260656ba-84c6-4585-9c3e-6db6404e6540.name: received_at
260656ba-84c6-4585-9c3e-6db6404e6540.comment: When the platform received this bundle (for producer_kind='external_hip').

7b286c07-b3ce-47fe-9f88-50adc0f753a8.name: storage_kind
7b286c07-b3ce-47fe-9f88-50adc0f753a8.comment: v1 always 'inline_jsonb'. Object storage is post-launch. | CHECK: storage_kind IN ('inline_jsonb','object_storage_ref')

32e49541-443f-44c9-afb4-be690c35d6f5.name: bundle_jsonb
32e49541-443f-44c9-afb4-be690c35d6f5.comment: When storage_kind='inline_jsonb'. The full FHIR Bundle. NULL when storage_kind='object_storage_ref'.

f783ef7e-a620-4196-a462-c44f37d651eb.name: object_storage_ref
f783ef7e-a620-4196-a462-c44f37d651eb.comment: When storage_kind='object_storage_ref'. URL to the bundle bytes in object storage. NULL when storage_kind='inline_jsonb'.

de73e260-4974-40c8-afa7-a079af3cb644.name: care_context_id
de73e260-4974-40c8-afa7-a079af3cb644.comment: The care_context row registered for this external record (with source_origin='external_abdm').

9aebf762-a963-4d0c-b6f6-20170dfc224a.name: consent_artifact_id
9aebf762-a963-4d0c-b6f6-20170dfc224a.comment: Refers to integration_hub.abdm_consent_artifacts.id under which this record was disclosed.

87aeb343-0a74-4aac-8903-8299de5104a4.name: source_hip_id
87aeb343-0a74-4aac-8903-8299de5104a4.comment: ABDM HIP id of the originating health information provider.

e4c8cf1f-a00b-4273-b8e3-d8ce7612d6ed.name: display_summary
e4c8cf1f-a00b-4273-b8e3-d8ce7612d6ed.comment: Parsed summary fields for fast timeline display: {title, sectionCount, attestor, encounterDate, primaryDiagnosis}. Derived from the bundle but stored denormalised so the timeline does not parse JSONB on every read.

f00b9aa3-b382-4039-80f9-9c4e40176774.name: doctor_viewed_at
f00b9aa3-b382-4039-80f9-9c4e40176774.comment: First time a doctor opened this record. Audit / 'unread badge' hint.

75dcf8b6-3bde-46e8-afa8-dbfae0bde640.name: data_erase_at
75dcf8b6-3bde-46e8-afa8-dbfae0bde640.comment: Denormalised from the consent artifact's permissions for fast erasure scheduling.

8367d4d3-fe3f-4045-baa5-245234e3df8c.name: occurred_at
8367d4d3-fe3f-4045-baa5-245234e3df8c.comment: The clinical date displayed (Composition.date for internal, encounterDate for external).

2376aac1-1ecc-4ca1-8287-34a0966f6612.name: subtitle
2376aac1-1ecc-4ca1-8287-34a0966f6612.comment: Secondary line (e.g., department, attending practitioner, primary diagnosis).

3ceedf93-b2ab-4944-b8c3-69da1294c898.name: consent_disclosable
3ceedf93-b2ab-4944-b8c3-69da1294c898.comment: Whether ABDM consent currently allows disclosure of this care context. Maintained by the consent.granted/revoked event consumers.

f172195c-a566-4f30-8b68-5ef47704ed06.name: erased_entity_id
f172195c-a566-4f30-8b68-5ef47704ed06.comment: The id of the erased row. The row no longer exists; this log preserves the reference.

55e063d0-939d-4326-a516-5aed9f1c388f.name: consent_artifact_id
55e063d0-939d-4326-a516-5aed9f1c388f.comment: Consent under which the original record was disclosed (when applicable).

e6148ec3-2844-4e6f-bbc6-6e2d86e7c74a.name: data_erase_at
e6148ec3-2844-4e6f-bbc6-6e2d86e7c74a.comment: The deadline that triggered this erasure.

314d3316-04fd-450c-88cd-68fa2660a654.name: erasure_actor
314d3316-04fd-450c-88cd-68fa2660a654.comment: 'scheduler' for time-driven erasure, 'manual:<user_id>' for manual revocations.

3fa33fa2-8087-43d0-96ea-341d2fccb614.value:
=== RECORD FOUNDATION CITUS DISTRIBUTION ===

Green (#c8e6c9): All 6 tables distributed by iq_tenant_id.

Boundary (per ADR-0021/0022):
- Record Foundation OWNS: care contexts, immutable FHIR Document Bundles, external HIU inbox, timeline projection, erasure log.
- Does NOT own: clinical source data (operational modules), patient identity (EMPI), ABDM consent artifacts (Integration Hub).

Logical references only -- no cross-distribution-column FKs.
- erasure_log.erased_entity_id is polymorphic (care_context | bundle_storage | external_health_record).
- external_health_records.consent_artifact_id refers to integration_hub.abdm_consent_artifacts.id (cross-schema, no FK).
- care_contexts.supersedes_id is a self-reference for FHIR Composition.relatesTo amendments.

bundle_storage rows are INSERT-only and DELETE-on-erasure. Never UPDATE.
